subject: Req acceleration request — Senior Infrastructure Engineer backfill (freeze exception)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Req acceleration request — Senior Infrastructure Engineer backfill (freeze exception)

Hi team,

Short ask: request approval for a freeze-exception and immediate sourcing for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer (backfill for A. Gomez, who is leaving end of November). This role is mission-critical for the next two quarters: we have the infra resilience sprint (Nov–Jan) and the KV cache migration that is on the critical path for Dedicated capacity cost reductions. Without a replacement we risk delaying the migration and exposing us to higher unit costs and capacity constraints.

Why now: the work is infra-facing (low ramp tax for existing systems), the candidate profile should be hireable in-market quickly, and the team can get the first deliverables within 8–10 weeks of start. Hiring a contractor is an option but we lose knowledge-transfer continuity and it will cost ~30% more for the same throughput.

Request:
- Approve a freeze exception for 1 headcount (Senior Infra Eng) and allow active sourcing immediately.
- Approve the attached req form (Req_Form_Senior_Infra_20261026.pdf).
- If budget owner needs to sign off, please confirm who (cost center) so I can route.

If you want, we can open as an SDE3 vs Staff split; my recommendation is SDE3 with a strong infra/ops background. I’ve copied Emma at TalentPlace to begin outreach if we get the green light.

Attachments: Req_Form_Senior_Infra_20261026.pdf

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Req acceleration request — Senior Infrastructure Engineer backfill (freeze exception)

Soojin —

I approve in principle. This sounds like a clear risk to the migration timeline and to our cost objectives. Before formal sign-off: please confirm the cost center and the target start date. If budget sign-off will take time, approve a contingency: allow the recruiter to start active sourcing and take candidates to initial screens; final offer contingent on budget approval.

If you think contractor interim is necessary to avoid blockers, include estimated delta vs perm in the req form.

Lauren
VP, Engineering Operations

- Cost center: ENG-PLATFORM-2 (owner: Marcus Lin)
- Target start: ideally 2026-12-01 (accepting 2027-01-03 at latest)

3) If we do not have viable candidates within 3 weeks of live posting, escalate to me and we will evaluate contractor interim or re-prioritization of the backlog.
